description: `multiverse tasks sandbox --acknowledge <task> --acknowledges <ordinal> --yes` appends an `event=acknowledged` line naming the right ordinal and changes no other field — the outcome record's own `status`/`state` stay exactly as recorded (cli.py `_cmd_tasks_acknowledge`/accounts.py `append_acknowledge_if_absent`).
